intro: Chipotle Mexican Grill is a fast-casual chain built around one idea: you build your own burrito, bowl, tacos or salad from fresh ingredients down the line. One base price covers your choice of chicken, steak, sofritas or veggie, with premium proteins, guacamole and queso as add-ons. Chipotle also posts calories for everything, so below is the full Chipotle menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A Chipotle burrito, burrito bowl, order of tacos or salad all start around $11.85 to $13.55 with your choice of chicken, steak, sofritas or veggie included. Barbacoa and carnitas add about $0.75, guacamole adds $2.95, and chips and guac are about $5.20. Calories depend on your build, from roughly 300 to over 1,000.
hot_deal: Chipotle Rewards and app deals: Chipotle runs free-delivery days and app or online-order promos through the year, plus macro-friendly Lifestyle Bowls (like the High Protein and Balanced Macros bowls) built for specific diets. Offers vary — check the Chipotle app.

faqs.q: How much is a burrito bowl at Chipotle?
faqs.a: A burrito bowl costs about $11.85 to $13.55 depending on your protein and location. Chicken, steak, sofritas and veggie are included; barbacoa and carnitas add around $0.75, and guacamole adds $2.95.
Guacamole is free on the veggie entree, but on meat entrees it is an add-on of about $2.95. A side of guac is $2.95 and chips and guac are about $5.20.

Chipotle offers chicken, steak, barbacoa (spicy shredded beef), carnitas (pork), sofritas (plant-based tofu) and veggie, plus seasonal options like Chicken al Pastor. Chicken, steak, sofritas and veggie are included in the base price.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Chipotle bowl?
faqs.a: It depends entirely on your build. A chicken bowl with rice, beans, salsa and cheese is roughly 700 to 900 calories; adding guac, queso and double meat can push it well over 1,000. Chipotle posts calories for every ingredient.
Lifestyle Bowls are pre-built bowls for specific diets, like the High Protein Bowl (850 cal, about $15.90), Balanced Macros Bowl and Keto Salad Bowl. You can order them by name in the app.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Chipotle?
faqs.a: The most ordered are the chicken burrito bowl, the steak burrito, chips and guacamole, the barbacoa bowl, and the chicken quesadilla.
